description:
Individual check executions for a service, newest first: output, latency and execution time per run.

Returns one row per check execution; list_service_state_changes covers only the
points where the state changed. A rising executionTime before a failure indicates a
timeout or resource exhaustion, an instant failure a configuration, auth or
service-down condition.

hostname.description: Exact host name. Required - there is no estate-wide form of this tool. Get a name from list_services_by_state, list_log_entries or get_container_tree first.

hours.description: How many hours back to look.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return. Defaults to 50, maximum 500.

servicename.description: Exact service name on that host. Required. get_host_info lists the services of a host, and list_services_by_state reports host and service together.

name: list_service_checks

outputSchema.description: Rows plus enough context to know whether they are all of them.

hint.description: How to narrow the query when truncated.

items.description: The rows, at most `limit` of them.

truncated.description: True if openITCOCKPIT held more rows than were returned.

title: Service Check History
